questions.title: Issued LinQ grant, собственная модель и принятое доказательство исполнения
questions.known: Прочитаны LinQ homepage/tech/sol, официальный анонс и вторичный linq_platform. Обещаны онлайн-доступ и inference на LinQ; публичная download/demo форма не даёт callable API, custom-model update или granted host.
questions.why: Нет полного кейса, issued manual/schema, account/grant, matched SDK/native/driver/firmware/model artifacts и принятого execution witness. CPU/mock соседей не device run.
questions.decision: Выбирает API, shell, managed video, job или unsupported-live. Service-only без SSH может быть достаточен; GUI-only без машиночитаемых результатов — нет.
questions.closure: Постановщик + полный кейс + issued артефакт + E001/E018. Сохранить manual revision, allowed model boundary/update, hashes golden input/model/output, request/run/device correlation и accepted witness.

questions.title: Remote lifecycle, quota, ambiguous submit и native input lifetime
questions.known: AWS Batch — один документированный аналог: cancel200 не terminal, running timeout не queue TTL, zero ListJobs не negative proof. Спроектирован persisted held ledger, отдельные local/control/fetch caps и bounded STOPPED.
questions.why: LinQ submit dedup scope/window, lookup visibility, definitive rejection, hidden retries, accepted/running weights, terminal/release/acceptance-cutoff/TTL и safe buffer release не выданы. Старый backup может не знать post-cutoff jobs.
questions.decision: Без доказанного release удержать remote credit через timeout/epoch/restart/restore. View TTL освобождает view bytes, не native borrowed input. Нет reliable reconcile — stop соответствующего admission, не held=0.
questions.closure: Issued manual/owner + E001/E007/E016. Только разрешённые benign calls; lost ACK в own fixture. Фиксировать tenant/quota namespace, terminal witness и режим без auto-resume.

questions.title: Разрешённое размещение decoder/pre/post и app data plane
questions.known: HPS optional video encode и HX/RK3588 decode — разные host/product claims. SSH/VPN не даёт root/Docker/ports/daemon lifetime. Remote compact boxes не обеспечивают analyzed pixels на local projection.
questions.why: Неизвестны host CPU/RAM/ISA/codec/permissions, source reachability, persistence, listeners/tunnel и права CPU NMS/wrapper. Нельзя считать remote RTSP из private LAN доступным.
questions.decision: При frame API весь app у команды. Remote decode minimum переносит единый app data plane/DB/recorder/projection к decoder только при полном grant; иначе thin worker и local decode. Возврат JPEG при remote decode — отдельный downlink.
questions.closure: Owner grant/network inventory + E001/E005/E008/E018; сравнить один clip в допустимых placements, отдельно CPU/network/privacy. Не устанавливать web/DB на shared host без предоставленного права.

questions.title: Реальные source codec/profile/FPS/GOP/bitrate/PTS
questions.known: RTSP/ONVIF/media controls различены; sampling после decode не снижает автоматически decode source FPS. Main/sub могут отличаться crop/FOV/clock; loop — simulated source.
questions.why: Нет организаторских видео/камер, firmware, profiles, ffprobe sample, B-frames/IDR bound, VBR distribution, source NTP/PTS discontinuity rules.
questions.decision: Определяет decode compatibility, encoder/GOP recovery, bytes/ring cap и timestamp mapping. Missing PTS запрещает exact clock по FPS/host now.
questions.closure: Полный кейс/source artifact/камера + ffprobe inventory и E002/E003/E009; сохранить hashes, codec/profile/pix_fmt/FPS/time_base/keyframe structure и raw timestamp trace.

questions.title: Domain temporal contract: required FPS/max gap/dwell/onset/ID
questions.known: Анонс перечисляет примеры нарушений. Gap не negative, mean5fps не max-gap guarantee, physical dwell не update count; короткое событие может не попасть sampler.
questions.why: Полный обязательный перечень/точность/задержка/минимальный coverage/ID continuity/onset и interruption semantics отсутствуют. Сетевой tracker поиск этих требований не устанавливает.
questions.decision: Без этого 5fps, T_fresh и max_gap — сценарии, не SLA. Снижение FPS/camera count допускается только в пределах метода; no-tracker route не заменяет ID-dependent метод.
questions.closure: Полный кейс + violation_methods/evaluation/operator_product + E004/E006/E017/E018. Versioned contract с units, denominators, cadence tolerance, missing-PTS policy и quality thresholds.

questions.title: Фактическое железо и CPU/QuickSync/NVDEC decode capacity
questions.priority: P0/P1 / inventory сразу, нагрузка после slice
questions.known: В контексте только RTX4070 и ноутбук. NVDEC13.0 Ada indicative table и T4 DeepStream7.1 — внешние измерения с иными условиями. Portable CPU/QuickSync decode-only per-core числа не найдены; encode/transcode отсечены.
questions.why: CPU, exact SKU/VRAM/driver/thermal power mode, codec backend/build, surfaces/copies и sustained throughput ещё не измерены.
questions.decision: Выбор software/hardware decode, threads/shards, resize-before-download и безопасный admission. Нельзя вывести число камер из 903fps, TOPS или одной raw latest-slot оценки.
questions.closure: Локальный hardware/build inventory + E003/E005. Указать source corpus/codec/GOP, warmed/cold, CPU-seconds/frame, decode+transfer+resize отдельно и per-camera freshness под paced load.

questions.title: LinQ usable full-chain cycle и per-camera feasibility
questions.known: Необходимы два ограничения: per-camera f_i≤p_i/E[L_i] и aggregate occupancy/capacity; L включает client NMS/cascade/ordered apply. p1,L300ms даёт≤3.33fps даже при K100.
questions.why: Нет measured L/tails, endpoint concurrency/thread-safety/batch, service capacity/shared fairness и minimum domain FPS/maxgap. 1/p95(L) не tail guarantee.
questions.decision: Не обещать 5fps/camera по aggregateFPS. p>1 — только при supported stateless/sequencing + bounded sparse sent-ID reorder и полезном выигрыше freshness.
questions.closure: Issued SDK/API/model + E005/E006/E008/E018 с реальным LinQ. Saturation curve и каждый camera admitted/applied/gaps/age; remote-held accounting отдельно от local parent slots.

questions.title: JPEG/resolution/chroma/ROI quality на целевых RGB СИЗ
questions.known: Два первичных исследования FLIR thermal/COCO показывают риск recall tiny/small. Их Q30/Q40/размерные bins и модели не PPE threshold. Q100 не lossless, camera baseline уже compressed.
questions.why: Нет target RGB labelled sample/модели/thresholds и paired predictions для каски, респиратора, сигареты, дальностей/освещения/толпы.
questions.decision: JPEG size — переменная distribution, не обещанное compression ratio. ROI discovery/crop fanout и resize могут менять quality/compute; нельзя экономить сеть без quality gate.
questions.closure: Datasets/model_stack/evaluation + E004. Paired encode grid с fixed model/preprocess; bytes/CPU и recall по классам/размеру плюс event missed/false alarms.

questions.title: Модель, batch/stateful sequence и каскадная NN-граница
questions.known: Triton/Hailo — только образцы. ROI discovery тоже работа; person/PPE cascade требует bounded q_max и secondary unknown при quota drop.
questions.why: Не выбраны actual model artifacts/input layout/dtype/quant scales/fixed or dynamic batches/state affinity, secondary cost и допустимая обязательная LinQ boundary.
questions.decision: Определяет preprocessing ownership, batch families, primary/secondary caps и допустимость temporal latest-drop. Не считать arbitrary uint8/JPEG/batch поддержанными.
questions.closure: Model_stack/linq_platform + issued artifacts/полный кейс + E001/E004/E005/E008. Каждый revision повторяет golden/parity; accepted NN boundary фиксируется отдельно от CPU postprocess.

questions.title: Event→original segment mapping и допустимость snapshot cut
questions.known: MediaMTX1.21.2 mtxi содержит recorder StreamID/SegmentNumber/DTS/NTP, не decoder/source epoch; hooks/UTC filename не дают source PTS. Native export теряет mtxi. Same-demux indexed remux — prospective route.
questions.why: Не выполнен packet-lifetime/reorder/rescale/coverage fixture; missing/duplicate PTS, loops, wrap, decoder-only/recorder-only restart, main/sub uncertainty не измерены.
questions.decision: До E009 нет exact clip claim. Gate fail → analyzed snapshot + optional native archive mapping unknown. Если full case требует exact clips, такой cut остаётся blocker.
questions.closure: Source inventory+собственный prototype+E009/E010/E016. Один H264 video-only профиль/дем ux owner, indices ДО mutable mux, independent decode watermark и 0false-complete.

questions.title: Finite evidence acceptance, pre/post/retention и квоты
questions.known: Unbounded remote delay нельзя покрыть finite ring. Проект L_evidence20/P5/Q5/S2/G≤1/C4/J30/H40s и chunk/rollover/quota bounds сохранён как fixture, не требования. Old onset после dwell учитывать отдельно.
questions.why: Нет требуемого evidence window/retention/допустимой partial/snapshot политики, actual max bitrate/GOP/disk и максимальной задержки выдачи.
questions.decision: Нужны finite pin admission deadlines, future ranges, job/count/byte caps и visible late/partial/unavailable; не расширять ongoing job бесконечно и не удалять pinned молча.
questions.closure: Полный кейс/operator_product+device/storage inventory+E010. Требования могут сделать snapshot cut недопустимым; long queue не исправляется только большим H.

questions.title: Target filesystem, commit/file sync, backup failure domain, RPO/RTO
questions.known: SQLite WAL+FULL, patched engine и successful COMMIT — выбранный proposal; DB transaction не включает обычные media files. Supported Connection.backup+verified closed-media inventory, restore/fencing/pin rebuild/remote reconcile описаны.
questions.why: Не известны FS/VFS/device caches/fsync/directory-persistence recipe, storage reserve, power/disk-loss behavior, backup interval/failure domain/key recovery и actual RPO/RTO. Ни один fault run не выполнен.
questions.decision: Process kill не power-loss proof; old backup не held=0. До pin rebuild запрещено retention deletion; missing original/unknown mapping не complete.
questions.closure: Exact target/диск+E010/E016; separate process crash, reboot, OS/power fault, disk loss на disposable authorized testbed; externally durable commit witness и verified backup cutoff.

questions.title: Processed view runtime: profile, credit, teardown и total RSS
questions.known: Pinned websockets17.0.1 чтение подтверждает directions watermarks и send≠render. Проект 1outstanding/connection, exact ACK after draw, credit-cycle age guard, active+closing admission caps; timeout terminal, не новый credit.
questions.why: Нет browser/OS/RTT/throughput/tiles/quality/age inventory; public close_timeout не доказанный wall-clock teardown bound, app-owned references не total kernel/browser RSS.
questions.decision: Профиль/количество tiles/FPS/connection cap допускаются по тесту; closing продолжает занимать budget. Экспериментальный transport.abort subclass не public websockets API и не mandatory minimum.
questions.closure: E011/E012 на exact Python/browser/TLS/proxy/OS; source checksum/ACK/draw trace, hidden/reconnect/blackhole и process RSS/FD/task trends. Physical scanout/operator read отдельно.

questions.title: Optional native browser video: codec, NAT и source↔RTP↔rVFC mapping
questions.known: MediaMTX reader/WHEP signaling lifecycle и ICE media path различны. H265/B-frames/browser ограничены; rVFC best-effort и не произвольный camera frame ID. HEAD reader W1 не lock к 1.21.2.
questions.why: Нет actual browser codec/selected candidate pair, TURN/cert/domain/port grants и sourcePTS→RTP/SSRC/epoch mapping uncertainty. HTTPS200 не media connectivity.
questions.decision: Плавный original live отдельно от analyzed own-frame view. Без mapping boxes на latest native frame не рисовать как measurement.
questions.closure: E013 на площадке; same-tag reader/server, OPTIONS/POST/PATCH/DELETE/CORS, UDP blocked/subpath/TURN и independent frame markers; exact overlay только после доказанного mapping.

questions.title: Provisional artifact baseline vs actual installed target/Astra
questions.known: Candidate MediaMTX1.21.2/PyAV16.0.1/CPython3.12.15 source/websockets17.0.1/linked patched SQLite3.51.3. CPython3.12.15 source-only; no official Windows installer. Exact PyAV Linux wheel был read-only inspected, не imported.
questions.why: Binary target OS/ISA/ABI/glibc/engine/Compose/image digests/driver и linked SQLite source_id/compile_options неизвестны. Python patch не определяет SQLite. Astra news scopes не support matrix приложения.
questions.decision: Не обновлять proprietary supplied env до client Python. Offline own bundle и LinQ network availability различны; W1 catalog snapshots не requirements lock.
questions.closure: E015 + issued/vendor supported artifacts. Verify actual Python connection SQLite advisory/PRAGMA; clean-target/offline-client smoke и полный golden. Поддержанный vendor backport документировать вместо угадывания version tuple.

questions.title: Лицензия фактически shipped code/native libs/weights
questions.known: 8catalog entries имеют direct repo scope. PyAV BSD wrapper не весь bundled libav/x264/x265/gnutls; Linux wheel strings/ZIP и workflow прочитаны. Roboflow nearest superseding license, Ultralytics AGPL/enterprise, SDK/weights отдельно.
questions.why: Нет полного shipped artifact inventory/transitive notices/source obligations, standalone ffmpeg buildflags/hash, proprietary redistribution terms и model/dataset licenses. Идеи из unused catalog не shipped dependency.
questions.decision: reuse_mode process/dependency/copied-code/idea-only меняет scope. Другой wheel/OS требует своего чтения. License repo нельзя объявлять license всего продукта.
questions.closure: Фактический manifest+primary license texts/vendor terms+E015; exact copied path nearest LICENSE и notices, model_stack/datasets. Не выполнять аудит unused projects ради каталога.

questions.title: Event rate, DB/broker need и external idempotency
questions.known: Одна SQLite БД/one writer/outbox — proposal; WS/SSE projection, CoreNATS ephemeral, Redis pending reclaim и broker QoS не exactly-once external effect. Crash after send beforemarker допускает duplicate.
questions.why: Нет required event/update rate, concurrent operator writers/retention, acceptable backlog и provider durable idempotency key/receiver inbox.
questions.decision: Брокер/PostgreSQL вводить после measured need; не держать DB lock во время network await. Один dispatcher для minimum, stable event_id/revision и восстановление history.
questions.closure: Полный кейс/operator_product+E014/E016. Event generator в units events/s, не cameraFPS; measured commit/backlog age/WAL/duplicates и receiver contract.

questions.title: Alarm delivery boundary, messenger accounts и product access
questions.known: Event decided/committed/provider accepted/browser drawn/operator acknowledged — разные endpoints. Telegram/MAX rates/docs прочитаны, не измерены/не отправлялись сообщения. MAX endpoint/auth/certificate менялись.
questions.why: Нет полного product канала/recipient IDs/токенов/правабота/MAX business access, network accessibility и accepted alarm boundary/age. Read receipt/latency SLA не установлены.
questions.decision: Core — event history/UI; messenger optional после access. Clip pending не задерживает initialalarm. Provider timeout после accept — uncertain outcome/possibleduplicate.
questions.closure: Operator_product+owner credentials+E014/E017. Fake provider сначала; реальные тестовые отправки только отдельно авторизованной практикой, не production recipients.

questions.title: Camera encrypted transport, tenant isolation и protected data boundary
questions.known: Axis/NIST/Docker дают scoped examples: HTTPS управления не encrypted RTSP; Digest не encryption; VLAN/firewall требуют flow inventory; auth проверяется у clip/stream endpoints; Compose secrets не encrypted vault.
questions.why: Неизвестны camera firmware/client TLS/SRTP/RTSPS/accounts, remote tenant isolation/upload retention/logging/delete policy, keys/permissions и approved routes.
questions.decision: Camera credentials только у нужного owner; browser получает authenticated application path. Remote decode/recording выбираются вместе с privacy/persistence policy и bandwidth.
questions.closure: Device/vendor/remote owner + E015 functional security checks: exact flow table, invalid-cert failures, viewer/operator/admin и secret redaction; право/КИИ → market_deployment.

questions.title: Долгая RTSP freshness/RSS, drift и reconnection
questions.known: Version-specific FFmpeg/GStreamer/PyAV/OpenCV параметры и negative cases сохранены. rtspsrc tcp-timestamp обходит drift, но burst source создаёт иной риск; timeout не bound frame age.
questions.why: Нет 2h/overnight paced run actual source/backend, control-alive-no-media, native hang cleanup и true/false tcp-timestamp comparison.
questions.decision: Backend/transport/watchdog выбирается по progress/RSS/watermark; ret=True, PID и socket alive недостаточны.
questions.closure: E002: pinned build/known source, slow consumer, disconnect/restart/media blackhole;10min correctness затем 2h/ночь при доступности. Publisher transcode не смешивать с isolated decode.

questions.title: Opaque tracker cadence/reset и ID quality
questions.known: ByteTrack fixed dt1/update, frame_rate только lost buffer; no-call freeze, valid empty(0,5) — observation, public gap/reset нет. New instance+tracking_generation — wrapper proposal; PTS не меняет dt.
questions.why: Нет tracker smoke/installability/footprint/domain ID metrics или допустимости short-gap carry. Старые np.float/imports и dependencies не tested, cadence/maxgap неизвестны.
questions.decision: Tracker optional по gate; cadence violation→reset/unknown. ID-dependent метод при failed gate — degraded/unsupported, не per-frame замена.
questions.closure: E006 с pinned reference, uniform/burst equal-mean/drop/empty/long-gap traces и separate annotated domain quality. Другая gap-aware реализация/адаптация требует validation.

questions.title: Направленные goodput/clock/resource coefficients для 50/500
questions.known: Input/return/view/control/storage сценарии и memory inventory сохранены.500 registered не 500 tiles/viewer; RAM включает DPB/surfaces/contexts/pools/borrows/TLS/DB, не один raw slot.
questions.why: Нет measured WAN↑↓/RTT/jitter/clock offset, FD/ports/sessions/processes/threads/VRAM/IO replay+backup и mcam/Cinf/Cdec/Cpre/Cwrite coefficients.
questions.decision: Нет единственного network X или числа LinQ плат.50 — candidate host после теста,500 — shards/sites roadmap; ресурсы проверяются вместе с per-camera temporal gate.
questions.closure: E003/E005/E008/E011/E016: topology/dataflow по host/direction, actual profile tails; same-host monotonic durations и optical/sync uncertainty для сквозного возраста.

questions.title: Camera image-health thresholds/false alarms/suitability
questions.known: Axis product docs разделяют image-health/причину вмешательства и unsuitable scenes. Progress/age mandatory; repeated/black/white/blur/shift — hypotheses suspected_anomaly.
questions.why: Нет сцен/thresholds/false alarms per camera-hour/CPU cost и day/night/static/detail-poor/legitimate PTZ controls. Overexposure heuristic не заявленная Axis capability.
questions.decision: Availability/staleness допустимы в core; image anomaly только с baseline/config revision/suitability и visible suspected label.
questions.closure: E019 с positive/negative controls; неразделимые controls→cut. Synthetic distortion не real-world tamper proof.

questions.title: Accepted fallback/replay и фактическая 45 ч feasibility
questions.known: 45 ч — арифметика официального расписания, не guaranteed LinQ uptime. Есть conditional minimum/5 owners/gates/cuts; ни один полный маршрут не запускался. CPU/RTX/replay должны быть marked.
questions.why: Full case, accepted witness/current grant/required features и реализация не подтверждены;225 person-hours не взаимозаменяемы.
questions.decision: Real LinQ golden выше optional features; GUI/job без usable output/cycle unsupported-live. Snapshot cut не закрывает обязательные exact clips.
questions.closure: Full case/organizer acceptance + E001/E018/checkpoint demo. Сохранить witness/trace, failure states, separate backend counts; saved run не current live.

questions.title: Actual output heads, NMS/quantization и return/postprocess budget
questions.known: Triton binary/ensemble — пример, не LinQ. Сценарий [1,84,8400]FP32=2822400B/frame против packed2404B для≤100detections; NMS/cap могут менять quality.
questions.why: Нет actual serialized response/names/shapes/dtypes/scales/layout/head semantics/classmap/coordinates/truncation/result retention. JSON wire bytes не numel×dtype.
questions.decision: Raw return может доминировать downlink/CPU/RAM; supported remote NMS/compact API меняет placement. Не делать NMS дважды и не cast dtype без контракта.
questions.closure: Model artifact/schema + E008: golden reference parity, crowded/empty/invalid/oversize caps, actual wire/poll/fetch/postprocess/full cycle.

experiments.title: Issued capability inventory и real LinQ golden path
experiments.decision: Выбрать supported access mode и доказать ровно один фактический inference нашей версии модели на LinQ.
experiments.inputs: Полный кейс, именной разрешённый grant/manual/schema, golden positive/negative inputs, model/preprocess reference и accepted execution witness; read-only host inventory только если shell предоставлен.
experiments.steps: Разделить model/control/data/lifecycle; зафиксировать custom model upload/update/select; выполнить один documented request, получить machine-readable output и terminal/release evidence; узнать hidden retries, quotas, source reachability и разрешённый restart. Если lifecycle непрозрачен, сохранить UNKNOWN и bounded stop.
experiments.metrics: Manual revision, hashes model/input/output/config, redacted request/result/job/run IDs, actual backend/device witness, OS/ISA/CPU/codec/permissions; measured local roundtrip отдельно от reported server durations.
experiments.outcomes: Callable custom service достаточен без SSH. Нет usable outputs/приемлемого cycle → unsupported-live/offline route и точный missing-grant packet. Не заменять LinQ GPU fallback.
experiments.limit: Один golden run не capacity, fairness, p99, TTL, качество всех классов или sustained realtime.

experiments.title: RTSP continuous reader, overload, failure и soak
experiments.decision: Выбрать PyAV/знакомый GStreamer, TCP/UDP, watchdog/reconnect и bounded latest-frame policy.
experiments.inputs: Pinned MediaMTX1.21.2, actual FFmpeg build, H264/H265720p/1080p25/30 samples с visible frame/clock/loop ID; source hashes, ffprobe JSON и GOP. Изолированный own test route.
experiments.steps: Loop publisher с -re -stream_loop -1 -c copy; сравнить naive sleep/read, continuous decode/latest и bounded raw queues. Медленный consumer200ms при source25fps; 2–3 источника, один stalls. Publisher/server disconnect, media-only blackhole/control alive, EOF/native hang; tcp-timestamp true/false при drift/burst.10min correctness затем 2h/ночь по доступности.
experiments.metrics: Watermark p50/p95/p99 age, input/decode/selected/applied FPS, RSS trend, decode errors, resets/reconnect reasons, fresh recovery time, queue drops, unaffected camera service; configs/versions/CSV/state trace/UI recording.
experiments.outcomes: Выбрать режим по freshness/CPU/RSS и bounded recovery, config/auth errors выделить. Неуспех isolation→исправить ownership/watchdog либо другой проверенный backend.
experiments.limit: Loop не live industrial camera; soak не LinQ throughput, качество событий или многосуточный production SLA.

experiments.title: Decode-only и полная цена model input: CPU/NVDEC/QuickSync
experiments.decision: Выбрать decode backend/threads/resize placement и actual admitted camera count.
experiments.inputs: Actual CPU/GPU/SKU/VRAM/OS/driver/power/cooling, pinned ffmpeg/PyAV/native library build; одинаковый H264/H265720/1080p corpus, profiles8/10bit420, GOP/B-frames. Publisher transcode не конкурирует за CPU.
experiments.steps: Warmup и≥3 repeats; isolated throughput без -re, затем paced1/2/4/8streams. Software1/default/2/4decoder threads; GPU path с проверенным hardware use/fallback disabled. Decode-only, download, GPU resize-before-download, color/letterbox и input packing измерять отдельно. QSV только после runtime/driver inventory.
experiments.metrics: CPU-seconds/frame и busy-core equivalents, wall frames/s, GPU video clocks/decode/memory, bytes copied, RSS/VRAM, p95 age при paced load; commands/buildconf/corpus hashes/raw measurements.
experiments.outcomes: Admit только sustained profile с reserve и agreed FPS/age; hardware capability без working build не pass. Оставить программный decode при отсутствии проверенного acceleration.
experiments.limit: Чужой 903fps не наша 4070, isolated max не RTSP reliability, LinQ inference или 500camera proof.

experiments.title: RGB compression, resize, ROI и sampling quality
experiments.decision: Определить допустимые payload/view/source profiles без скрытой потери мелких нарушений.
experiments.inputs: Размеченные целевые RGB PPE/zone scenes, разные размеры/свет/толпа, fixed model/threshold/preprocess. Baseline decoded source уже может быть lossy. Полный кейс задаёт допустимую quality loss.
experiments.steps: Paired JPEG Q95/85/75/60/50 с fixed encoder/chroma, отдельно resize grid. Crop original vs crop recompressed frame; crowd r и bounded ROI fanout, full-frame discovery cost. Сравнить 25fps→select5fps, NONKEY, source-native5fps, GOP25/50/100/B0 и gaps. Сузить grid после finding.
experiments.metrics: Bytes distribution mean/p95/p99/max, encode/decode CPU, class/size recall/AP, event missed/false alarms, short-act loss, source delta/coverage, geometry parity; paired predictions, examples и hashes.
experiments.outcomes: Profile допускается по согласованным class/event thresholds. Fail→повысить detail/изменить placement или честно ограничить сценарий; не замещать падение recall стабильной precision.
experiments.limit: FLIR/COCO Q thresholds не PPE; каска не сигарета, Q100 не lossless, снижение CPU не качество inference на LinQ.

experiments.title: Paced saturation, fairness, cascade и полный resource budget
experiments.decision: Выбрать C/B/p_i, admitted cameras и размещение по per-camera freshness/gaps, не aggregate throughput.
experiments.inputs: Source corpus+required FPS/maxgap/age, actual topology/goodput, granted quota; сначала tagged dummy delay route, затем real LinQ. Decoder/record/view/replay/backup ownership counters.
experiments.steps: B1,C1/2/4/8/16 до разрешённого knee, затем supported batches. Constant offered pacing, step overload/recovery, fast/slow/stalled/crowded source, q0..qmax ROI; p1 vs2/3 при fullcycle50/160/200/300/500ms synthetic fixture. Empty view→3×4tiles→slow/hidden→replay+backup.50/500 только при стенде/правах, иначе symbolic extrapolation.
experiments.metrics: Every camera admitted/completed/fresh ordered applied FPS, max media/wall gaps, age quantiles с full denominator, drop reasons, byte/count caps, remote held/unknown, post CPU. FD/handles/processes/threads/sockets/contexts/surfaces/pools/RSS/PSS/VRAM, NIC↑↓, disk Bps/IOPS/latency, WAL/replay/backup; raw traces/configs/hashes.
experiments.outcomes: Pass — одновременно agreed per-camera coverage/age, app/resource caps и measured reserve. Knee без fresh throughput→не наращивать C. Reduce admission/profile/viewers/placement только с quality gate. Camera reduction не лечит p1 single-camera ceiling.
experiments.limit: Mock L не LinQ prediction; Little-law means не tails; one-stream peak и synthetic500 не 500 real cameras/general quality.

experiments.title: Ordering/epochs, fixed-dt tracker, valid empty и domain gaps
experiments.decision: Проверить temporal contract, p>1 reorder и допустимость выбранного ID-dependent метода.
experiments.inputs: Pinned ByteTrack reference при необходимости, отдельный compatible environment; actual method minFPS/maxgap/ID rules, boxes+empty(0,5), source PTS0,.2,.4 vs0,.2,2.4; annotated PPE episodes.
experiments.steps: Sparse sent100/105/110; ответы 110→105→timeout100→late100, duplicate105, epochE1→E2, timeout wakeup без reply. Compare no-call, real empty, synthetic empty (negative control), new instance/tracking_generation; strict lost > boundary и reactivation-before-expiry. Equalmean uniform/burst/drop/2sgap/reconnect traces; ID quality отдельно от contract.
experiments.metrics: Append-only sent/arrival/apply/gap/reset/reject/remote-credit trace, KF covariance/framecounter/lost/removed, globalID scope, queue bytes, source deltas и coverage, event recall/false alarms/fragmentation и ID metrics; versions/input hashes.
experiments.outcomes: 0old epoch/out-of-order apply, no unsent101 wait, один live outcome/request, Gap не negative и не remote release. Cadence violation→explicit reset/unknown; чрезмерные resets→degraded/unsupported method. Variable-dt adaptation требует своего quality validation.
experiments.limit: Correct wrapper trace не качество ID/re-ID; timestamps/frame_rate constructor не variable dt; mock ordering не LinQ lifecycle.

experiments.title: Persisted remote ledger: fake-job fault/restart fixture
experiments.decision: Доказать наши reservation/release invariants и honest STOPPED без достаточного external contract.
experiments.inputs: Собственный fake service, durable DB, deterministic virtual clock/service active-job log. idempotent_submit on/off, visibility/keyretention/TTL cases; K_remote2/local submit1/control1 — fixture, не LinQ.
experiments.steps: Crash до/после intent commit/send/accept/ack/jobID persist; lostack, sameUUID/differenthash, hiddenretry как 2jobs, cancel200 continuing work, status404/unknown enum, epoch/live timeout, restart с 2held, terminal duplicate, DB ack/release commiterror. Отдельно lateacceptance после предполагаемого TTL.
experiments.metrics: Ordered intent/send/accept/ack/poll/terminal/release trace, row snapshots/hash/job IDs, service active IDs, held/local slots/bytes, double releases, stale applies, fixture revision/seed.
experiments.outcomes: 0≤held≤2, каждый возможно active job покрыт reservation, terminal release ровно один. Нет dedup/full TTL/acceptance cutoff→bounded STOPPED; unknown не исчезает после restart. Fail→учесть retries/ownership/atomicity, не разрешить свежие submits ради progress.
experiments.limit: Virtual duration не runtime latency; fixture не подтверждает LinQ contract, DB power durability или general reliability.

experiments.title: Output schema, numerical parity, NMS placement и return path
experiments.decision: Выбрать raw/compact return и postprocess placement, реальные downlink/CPU/RAM coefficients.
experiments.inputs: Actual serialized result+all head schemas/scales/classmaps, reference model/preprocess/thresholds/quantization; remote wrapper только при grant. Labelled crowded/empty target sample.
experiments.steps: Сверить body bytes с shape/dtype/batch mapping, endian/layout, head decode/NMS/coordinate transforms. Rawreference vs compact parity в объявленной tolerance; empty/max/invalidshape/oversize/truncation. Измерить polls/status/fetch/postprocess вместе с actual path, не переменить dtype наугад.
experiments.metrics: Mean/p95/max wire bytes/output, poll QPS/bytes/visibility delay, fetch/post CPU durations local clocks, peak live buffers/RSS, fullcycle/fresh FPS, paired detections/quality/cap misses; schema/reference hashes.
experiments.outcomes: Parity и bounds→зафиксировать output/postprocess revision и directional50/500 variables. Raw доминирует→remote compact при разрешении; unavailable→admission/architecture cut. AlreadyNMS output не NMS повторно.
experiments.limit: Oneframe CPU не 500capacity; postprocess parity не обязательное execution proof LinQ; scenario[1,84,8400] не actual chosen model.

experiments.title: Early event→original mapping proof: same-demux indexed remux
experiments.decision: Допустить exact event→original route либо сразу выбрать snapshot cut.
experiments.inputs: Pinned MediaMTX1.21.2/PyAV16.0.1 с actual libav build; H264 video-only B0/B2, GOP1/10s, VFR, visible frame/loop/clock IDs и hashes. Собственный same-demux indexed remux и native archive для сравнения.
experiments.steps: Индексировать packet PTS/DTS/rational time_base/codec/random-access ДО mutable mux rebase; отдельные refs/lifetime для decode. Сопоставить yielded frame с independently decoded closed original. Inject decoder-only/recorder-only restart, reset/continuous loop, backward PTS vs reorder, известный wrap, missing/duplicate PTS, UTC jump и main/sub negative controls.
experiments.metrics: Packet/frame/output sample trace, distinct source/decoder/recorder generations, original/output time_base и offsets, mtxi/manifest/hashes; wrong-original/loop, внутренние gaps, max grid error и mapping uncertainty.
experiments.outcomes: 0 false complete; любое неоднозначное соответствие unknown/partial. Fail→analyzed snapshot, native archive mapping unknown и custom recorder off. Если exact clips обязательны, это blocker; имя файла UTC не обход.
experiments.limit: Один fixture не arbitrary camera/codec/RTCP/main-sub/power-loss/LinQ и не доказанная 45 ч feasibility. Наличие PTS само по себе не lineage proof.

experiments.title: Finite evidence windows, pins, low-space и recorder crash
experiments.decision: Проверить конечные count/bytes/lifetime и honest partial/unavailable.
experiments.inputs: Own ring/DB/media test volume, измеренный GOP/max bitrate, E009 для complete. H40/P5/Q5/L20/C4/J30s, chunk10s/rollover60s/finite incident quota — только fixture.
experiments.steps: Результаты с delay1/19/21/120s, long dwell/30min ongoing media, stalled post-roll/no IDR, duplicate event/manual expiry/dead worker; concurrent retention/export/low-space. Kill create-before-init/part-write/close/index/hash/publish. Scan/reconcile, validated prefix derivative, future pin intent и reserved bytes на диске, pin rebuild до deletion.
experiments.metrics: Requested/actual intervals/gaps/generations/hashes; transition/deadline reasons; reservations/unique retained bytes, owner pins/refcounts, GOP/open-part reserve, oldest job и event revisions.
experiments.outcomes: 0 false complete; late/lost coverage→partial/unavailable. Каждый job terminal≤J+bounded dispatch jitter, metadata incident продолжается после evidence quota. Low-space не удаляет pinned молча; snapshot тоже bounded.
experiments.limit: Finite local policy не remote queue SLA/recall; process kill не power/disk loss; H40s не универсальная глубина и не число камер.

experiments.title: Processed WS renderer: slow/hidden/fanout/ACK/lifetime
experiments.decision: Проверить same-frame renderer и 1outstanding/viewer через slow/hidden/reconnect.
experiments.inputs: Exact pinned Python/websockets/browser/OS; JPEG с крупным frame ID и own boxes, near-cap profile;3viewers fast/decode3s/hidden60s. Tiny raw pool/checksums/8bounded requests для lifetime.
experiments.steps: Producer10fps, ACK off, main-thread stall/hide/reconnect, старый image до close event, wrong/future/duplicate nonce ACK и early ACK в SENDING. Busy выставляется до await; credit до send; bitmap.close/finally; elapsed credit-cycle check перед draw. Source reset во время decode, oversize header/JPEG/boxes/dimensions/DPR и reconnect до cleanup.
experiments.metrics: State/key/send/draw/ACK trace, checksum frame/box, retained-view vs borrowed-input counters, latest/outstanding/closing counts, bitmap lifecycle, heap/process RSS/FD, UI capture и drop reasons.
experiments.outcomes: Outstanding≤1/connection, decode≤1/page через поколения, no old-generation draw/mismatch/extra credit; fast viewer не ждёт slow. Timeout terminal, не новый credit. Malicious ACK после receive может лгать о draw — зафиксировать ограничение.
experiments.limit: App-owned reference bounds не total RSS/kernel/browser cap; canvas ACK не physical scanout/operator read; mock не LinQ safe input release.

experiments.title: Blocked transport, public close и bounded cleanup
experiments.decision: Оценить public-only close и выбрать проверенную mitigation при failure.
experiments.inputs: Own isolated exact OS/TLS/proxy/Python/websockets route; peer stops reads, rate≪B/deadline, loss/blackhole, large valid payload.
experiments.steps: Send→deadline→CLOSING→public close с repeated connection attempts. Не cancel/send-again в том же connection. Active+closing остаются в finite admission cap. Отдельная experimental ветка create_connection/subclass сохраняет asyncio transport и вызывает documented abort; это не public websockets API.
experiments.metrics: Task dumps, send/close elapsed, closing age/count, transport buffers где доступны, socket FD/handles before/after, memory trends и cleanup logs; TLS/proxy yes/no.
experiments.outcomes: Нет новых send/resources сверх cap после timeout. Hanging teardown — failure public-only route; visible unavailable/admission stop и затем E-tested mitigation. Не вычёркивать closing из budget по таймеру.
experiments.limit: Одна OS не universal TCP/kernel release; source read/close_timeout не hard wall cap; abort не гарантия browser/native RSS release.

experiments.title: Optional native WebRTC/LL-HLS и browser mapping
experiments.decision: Допустить optional original live и установить условия overlay.
experiments.inputs: Same-version MediaMTX server/reader, actual codec/GOP/browser/OS, network/cert/domain/TURN grant, watermark/frame ID corpus.
experiments.steps: LAN/hotspot/NAT/UDP blocked/HTTPS proxy/subpath/TURN TCP. Проверить OPTIONS/POST201 Location/PATCH/DELETE/Link/CORS, selected candidate pair, H264 B0/H265 negative; rVFC fields/source PTS→RTP/SSRC/epoch mapping, viewport/DPR. Overlay disabled при unknown mapping.
experiments.metrics: Time-to-first-frame, glass-to-glass p50/p95 с quantization, bitrate/CPU/RSS30–60min, reconnect, skew/no-match/stale и UI/packet metadata.
experiments.outcomes: Нет codec/media route→processed view либо проверенный HTTP fallback с visible delay. Exact overlay только с measured mapping; original live может работать без inference.
experiments.limit: HTTP200/STUN docs не media connectivity;600ms part math не benchmark, домашний тест не площадка, rVFC не arbitrary camera ID.

experiments.title: Event/outbox durability, replay и optional notifier
experiments.decision: Проверить сохранность committed incidents и честно показать possible duplicates.
experiments.inputs: Own DB/fake receiver с durable inbox/idempotency on/off,429 retry_after/500/timeout до и после accept, required event rate, disconnected UI/history cursor.
experiments.steps: Kill до commit/после commit до send/после accept до marker; provider/broker offline, poison payload, stale lease/fencing. Valid/expired cursor replay/snapshot resync. Overall/per-recipient rates и bounded retry/backoff/jitter. Реальный test bot/chat/clip/link — только отдельно авторизованной практикой.
experiments.metrics: Unique event_id/revision/outbox keys, commit operation IDs/attempts/external IDs, pending oldest age/count, commit p95/WAL, receiver effects и дубли; provider accept/browser draw/operator ack отдельно.
experiments.outcomes: Committed event/outbox восстанавливаются в заявленном process-crash scope; receiver inbox даёт dedup его DB effects. Без provider idempotency duplicate возможен. Broker/PostgreSQL только после measured need.
experiments.limit: Fake не Telegram/MAX access/latency; Message response не read receipt, QoS/Kafka transactions не external exactly-once или power durability.

experiments.title: Artifact/runtime/offline/Astra/security gate
experiments.decision: Зафиксировать фактический bundle и проверить ровно target configuration.
experiments.inputs: Разрешённый clean target OS/ISA/glibc/driver, artifacts/hashes/licenses/model/static assets, installed/supplied engine/Compose/host drivers. Proprietary LinQ environment отдельно.
experiments.steps: Verify hashes offline; inventory CPython/av.library_versions/library_meta/websockets и linked SQLite source_id/compile_options/PRAGMAs именно Python connection. Reject unpatched WAL либо документировать vendor backport. Load images/up--no-build--pull never без CDN/pip/apt/model downloads. Web→volume→decode→LinQ golden→event/view/restore. Astra edition/kernel/policy/device/rootless только approved config; auth roles, invalid TLS/token, log/frontend secret redaction.
experiments.metrics: Final artifact/lock manifest, platform/build flags/transitive notices/hashes, image IDs/digests, source_id/PRAGMA returns, redacted startup/network logs, sample→event trace и access/flow table.
experiments.outcomes: 0 missing mandatory imports/ABI; patched SQLite доказан, own offline client не fetch packages. Fail→supplied environment/isolated worker/remote API/scope cut; не менять shared SDK/mandatory protection наугад.
experiments.limit: Source pin не binary/installed; offline images не offline LinQ; UI на Astra не driver support/сертификат; functional security checks не pentest/IEC compliance.

experiments.title: SQLite commit/fault, supported backup/restore и remote reconciliation
experiments.decision: Проверить acknowledged commit, verified backup и safe admission после restore.
experiments.inputs: Own isolated exact patched SQLite/local FS, event/outbox/ledger/pins/media fixture, disposable bounded volume; externally durable witness для разрешённых power classes, не общий стенд.
experiments.steps: Kill before/after BEGIN/write/COMMIT/response; BUSY/IOERR/disk-full/long-reader WAL growth. Connection.backup в maintenance window + immutable media inventory/holds/hash; integrity_check+foreign_key_check. Создать remote obligations после cutoff, restore в новый каталог, fence old owners/new boot, orphan/missing/tail validation и pin rebuild до retention, documented remote reconcile. Reboot/forced OS/power/disk loss отдельно.
experiments.metrics: Commit IDs/recovered rows, WAL/journal сохранены, errors/queue/durations; backup cutoff/schema/runtime/hashes, missing/orphan/partial statuses, refcounts/reservations/held before/after, failed backup publication, measured RPO/RTO/witness.
experiments.outcomes: 0 acknowledged success без recovered commit в declared process-crash scope; no event without outbox, no failed backup published, no false complete/deletion до rebuild. Post-cutoff unknown не free credit; no reliable reconcile→STOPPED. File publish durability требует actual FS recipe.
experiments.limit: Process kill не power/disk loss, integrity_check не FK/media/remote proof, checksum не fsync; один backup не HA/универсальная durability.

experiments.title: Alarm latency с onset/dwell и полным denominator
experiments.decision: Измерить agreed event-to-operator endpoint и отделить compute/video latency.
experiments.inputs: Controlled physical onset/разметка, temporal dwell contract, paced source/actual LinQ/view/recording, optical source+screen запись либо доказанная clock sync с error bound.
experiments.steps: Phase sweep sampler,1camera затем admitted load. Каждый planned episode с ID: physical onset/first qualifying frame/rule eligible/committed/delivered-drawn/optional operator ack. Cold/steady/reconnect; misses/timeouts/session-ended pending остаются в denominator.
experiments.metrics: Raw same-host monotonic durations+clock domain/UTC uncertainty; end-to-end p50/p95/p99 с n/warmup/load, fraction offered alerted within SLA, missed/censored/downtime; optical evidence и quantization bound.
experiments.outcomes: Total quantiles только из e2e traces/совместимых histograms, не сумма stage p95/средний worker p95. При>1% timeouts не обещать unconditional p99 ниже deadline по success subset; показать short-event misses.
experiments.limit: Canvas ACK не physical scanout/operator read; success latency не event recall, mock/media test не LinQ или другая сеть.

experiments.title: Integrated minimum/mode go-no-go
experiments.decision: Проверить required vertical slice и выбрать конкретный scope cut.
experiments.inputs: Issued grant/full case, golden model/input/reference/accepted witness, actual selected bundle, positive/empty/error/late/old-generation fixtures.
experiments.steps: Real LinQ→1source→own-frame view→event commit/history→snapshot/clip status, затем 2camera isolation. Raw/compact parity, ambiguous submit/restart, gap/order/epoch, early E009 либо snapshot cut, slow viewer/DB fault/backup-restore/clean target. Gates0–2/2–6/6–18/18–32/32–40/40–45 ч — план.
experiments.metrics: Trace packet source/frame→request/model→LinQ run→result→event revision→evidence coverage→draw/ACK; ledger/pins before/after restart, versions/hashes/planned outcomes, required quality/FPS/gaps/age и visible failure states.
experiments.outcomes: Pass: actual LinQ и full-case required route/temporal/persistence contracts. Нет automated result/cycle→unsupported-live. Exact clips required+mapping fail→blocker; иначе согласованный snapshot cut. Optional native/messenger/blur/broker/extra cameras после core.
experiments.limit: Mock не pass;2camera не 50/500/industrial proof; saved witnessed replay не current live; proposal не доказанная 45 ч feasibility.

experiments.title: Camera-health positive/negative controls
experiments.decision: Оставить progress/age либо допустить ограниченные suspected image signals.
experiments.inputs: Annotated day/night/static/detail-poor/machinery corpus, known onset/hash/baseline/ROI; repeated pixels/new PTS, repeated PTS/new pixels, loop continuous/reset, corrupt/black/white/blur/shift.
experiments.steps: По одному фактору и controls lights-off/IR switch/white wall/truck/legitimate PTZ; restore/relearn/suitability. Отдельно transport blackhole с control alive. Bounded downsample/rate, thresholds/config revision.
experiments.metrics: Signal/delay timeline, false alarms/camera-hour/scene, recovery/hysteresis/CPU budget, confusion table/source/config/UI statuses.
experiments.outcomes: Mandatory: no progress→stale в watchdog+tolerance; новые frames не analysis healthy. Optional: согласованные false-alarm/delay на этой выборке, unsuitable→unknown/suspected; неразделимые controls→cut.
experiments.limit: Synthetic distortion не real-world tamper proof/причина вмешательства/quality PPE; универсальных thresholds нет.
